book_name: 合浦近扭白蚁 Pericapritermes hepuensis
en: The entry for this species survives only as figure captions, which enumerate the soldier head and pronotum in dorsal and lateral view, the postmentum, the mandible and the antenna, together with the worker head and mandible. No descriptive text is attached to them, so neither colour, pilosity, proportions nor antennal segmentation can be summarized, and no caste description is offered here. The species is recorded from Hepu in Guangxi. Separation from its congeners must therefore rely on the original figures.
